final_name.description:
West of Heartland Overflow, west and northwest of the 'A' in New Hanover.
The other good spot is on the Great Plains, southwest of Blackwater. They tend to spawn during the day but not exclusively.

final_name.description:
Pelicans are the best source of Exotic Bird Meat. A good spot is just east of Quaker's Cove.
As you come down the road into the cove, to the left is a beach area where they often sit.

final_name.description: Fast travel to Emerald Station, then go northeast across the train tracks. In the area between the train track and the road above 'EMERALD STATION' on the map are a couple of patches, with more beside the railway line if you follow the curve northeast. [#2]
all_descriptions: From MacFarlane's Ranch, go to Harriet's tent. There's a patch just in front of it, and also a couple of patches on the S-Bend in the road nearby. [#1]

Head to Armadillo and then go north along the railway line road, you often see one perched on top of the telegraph poles there.
Swap lobbies to get more spawns. [#1]
